Title: Losing Collagen Fast? 3 Daily Habits That Age Your Skin Faster

Description:
Three everyday habits break down collagen faster than any cream can fix: smoking, which triggers MMP enzymes that degrade collagen and gives smokers 2-3x more facial wrinkles; unprotected sun exposure, which triggers the same MMP response even without visible redness; and a high-sugar diet, which stiffens collagen through glycation. Quitting smoking, wearing sunscreen daily, and cutting back on added sugar all help protect it.
